headline: Congress goes dark for a long weekend, with both chambers running skeleton schedules Friday ahead of Tuesday's pro forma sessions.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session on Friday, October 9, meeting briefly at 1:30 p.m. before adjourning until Tuesday. No business was conducted beyond the minimal proceedings required to keep the chamber technically in session.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on Friday, October 9, adjourning after just two minutes at 12:32 p.m. The chamber processed introductions of 27 new bills and 4 resolutions, along with nine committee reports focused on small business and Veterans Affairs initiatives, before adjourning for the recess period.
